title: FE↔SEC-001: Frontend Security Review + CSP Requirements
description: Security provides token-handling requirements (JWT storage/refresh/revocation), session-management policy, Content Security Policy (CSP) requirements, vulnerability-scan results, and frontend threat-model findings (XSS/CSRF/token exfiltration); Frontend provides authentication/authorization implementation details, dependency manifests (lockfile, SBOM), and build artifacts for security assessment. Grounded in SECURITY_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.12 and FRONTEND_DASHBOARD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.7.

frontend_security_evidence.description: FE→SEC: implementation details + manifests for review.

authn_authz_details.description: Token lifecycle, OAuth 2.0 flow, role-based UI gating.

dependency_manifest_provided.description: package lockfile + SBOM provided for scanning.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Frontend application security (token handling, CSP, XSS/CSRF) is security-relevant: ESC-SEC applies — agents may only propose; SEC owns the binding review verdict. Not the core device/OTA baseline, hence Tier-2 rather than Tier-1, but a BLOCKED verdict gates the dashboard release.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (security review at major release milestones touching authentication, session management, or new data-surfacing features; ad hoc on auth-flow changes and new CSP requirements)
confirm_conditions: token_handling.storage and a CSP with csp_header_required = true are specified
Frontend provided authn/authz details and the dependency manifest (lockfile + SBOM)
vuln_scan run with open_critical = 0 on the release path
review_verdict = APPROVED (or CONDITIONAL with conditions logged and scan counts disclosed)
reject_conditions: review_verdict = BLOCKED (unresolved frontend security risk — gates the release; ESC-SEC)
token stored in localStorage where the requirement mandates an httpOnly cookie (baseline deviation)
open_critical > 0 presented as release-ready, or CSP header omitted
counter_conditions: CONDITIONAL verdict — request the remediation conditions be logged to the §3.3 checklist before proceeding (do not self-clear)
SBOM missing a third-party script — request a complete manifest before assessment
